title: How many customers in customers.csv have no email address?

turns.prompt: How many customers in customers.csv have no email address?
Which country has the most customers without an email? Leave out test accounts.

o1.label: Original
o1.prompt: How many customers in customers.csv have no email address?

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import csv
r=list(csv.DictReader(open('customers.csv')))
print(len(r), sum(1 for x in r if not (x['email'] or '').strip()))"

steps.text: 12 of the 60 customers in `customers.csv` have no email address. I counted rows where the email field is empty or only whitespace.

o2.label: Original
o2.prompt: Which country has the most customers without an email? Leave out test accounts.

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import csv
for x in csv.DictReader(open('customers.csv')):
    if not (x['email'] or '').strip() or 'test' in (x['name']+x['email']).lower(): print(x)"

steps.text:
**Canada** has the most customers without an email, with 4 (IDs 9, 24, 31 and 45).

I excluded two test accounts from the 12 customers with no email: ID 12 (`TEST ACCOUNT`, Germany) and ID 41 (`test user`, Japan). I identified them by "test" in the name, since the file has no explicit test-account flag. That leaves 10 customers.

| Country | No email, excluding tests |
|---|---|
| Canada | 4 |
| Germany | 3 |
| Brazil | 2 |
| Kenya | 1 |

If the test accounts had stayed in, Germany would have had 4 and tied with Canada.

6565fa0b.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5 · edited prompt
6565fa0b.prompt: Which country has the most customers without an email?

input.command:
python3 -I -c "
import csv,collections
r=list(csv.DictReader(open('customers.csv')))
c=collections.Counter((x['country'] or '').strip() for x in r if not (x['email'] or '').strip())
print(c.most_common())"

steps.text:
Canada and Germany tie for the most customers without an email, with 4 each.

Here is the full breakdown of the 12:

| Country | No email |
|---|---|
| Canada | 4 |
| Germany | 4 |
| Brazil | 2 |
| Japan | 1 |
| Kenya | 1 |

As before, I treated an empty or whitespace-only email as missing.
